svg.title: Experience
svg.desc: Experience: Lead Software Architect, MobileESports (part of BoomBit) (Dec 2022 – now); Software Engineering Team Lead, Betsson Georgia (Mar 2026 – Jun 2026); Associate Partner, Software Development Chapter Lead, TBC Bank (Apr 2023 – Mar 2026); Software Solutions Architect, Kanti (May 2024 – Oct 2025); Deputy Head of IT Department, Service Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia (Nov 2020 – Apr 2023); Senior Software Developer, TBC Bank (May 2020 – Nov 2020); Software Solutions Architect, Greennet (Sep 2019 – May 2020); Senior Software Developer, Technical Lead, Softx (Jun 2018 – May 2020); Android Developer, GoRealTravel (formerly GoRealEurope) (May 2019 – Apr 2020); Senior Software Developer, Treepex (Nov 2017 – May 2018); Android Developer, Tbilisi State University (Sep 2017 – Dec 2017); Junior Software Developer, Ministry of Defence of Georgia (Jun 2017 – Nov 2017); Junior Software Developer, Revenue Service of Georgia (May 2016 – Jul 2016).
svg.text: Architected the platform from scratch and launched it in 8 months: 40+ microservices, 2.6M+ users,
3.4M+ payout transactions, ~2,900 automated tournaments a day, 99.98% availability and ~50
production deployments a week. Built the fraud-prevention system (43,000+ accounts blocked or
Led ~15 engineers across five product teams. Migrated Sports services to AWS (EKS, RDS,
ElastiCache, Amazon MQ), cutting their infrastructure costs by 30% and making their API responses
35% faster; archived 300+ repositories and decommissioned 50+ obsolete services.
Associate Partner, Software Development Chapter Lead
Led the Backend Chapter of 10–20 engineers across 10+ product teams and recruited 20+ engineers.
Broke the vendor's monolith into ~15 in-house asynchronous microservices and personally built the
Transfers service, handling 1–1.5M transactions a day.
Designed and single-handedly built the backend of a raffle platform for the 16th energy drink brand:
10M+ unique product QR codes, millions of participants and an automated daily draw engine.

text.tspan: Service Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Georgia

svg.text: Built and led a ~60-person technology organization. Modernized 26+ legacy Delphi and classic ASP
applications into .NET microservices, served tens of thousands of citizens daily through two mobile
apps, a web portal and APIs, and managed 30+ secure integrations.
Moved vendor B6 front-office modules (cash-in/cash-out, customer registration) in-house and rolled
the system out from a pilot branch to all branches.
Led Cisco AppDynamics observability pre-sales and consulting for 10–15 banks, government agencies,
Led 6 developers and coded full-stack (.NET, Angular) on platforms for Global Benefits Georgia, Silknet
(silksport.ge) and a multi-tenant SaaS serving 15–20 salons.
Sole Android developer of a travel app covering 85+ cities across Europe and Asia, with offline booking
Built web, B2B and backend platforms for tens of thousands of customers, plus a ranger Android app
Sole Android developer of a grant-funded student social and career platform with profiles, job postings
Independently designed, built and deployed Indact, a legal document management system used across
the Ministry for tens of thousands of legal acts.
Built features for the public taxpayer Android app, shipped to production.
